title: Method C Phase 3: Step-2 Forward Crack Propagation Package on Refined Mesh
review_directive: Job-3 forward crack propagation solve is authorised as a single bounded authorisation: max 1 PBS job, cumulative PBS 59 -> 60. Create the Job-3 PBS script (submit_demo_propagation_job3.pbs) following the Job-2 pattern (16 CPUs SMP, 48 GB RAM, 72:00:00 walltime, queue entry_imfdfkmq routing to normal_imfdfkmq, modules gcc/11.4.0 + intel/2024.2.0 + abaqus/2023, notifications wired), then submit the prepared Job-3 deck PK_METHOD_C_DEMO_PROPAGATION_JOB3.inp (30,897 layered elements, two steps: Step-1 re-equilibrate at u2=0.0050 mm, Step-2 propagate to u2=0.0100 mm, frozen UEL CE8D5EDC) via scripts/hpc/Invoke-Mode1Execution.ps1. When Job-3 completes, verify the true exit code from the .sta/.msg/.log, then extract and report: crack extension length (x-coordinate where d >= 0.95 along y=0.50 mm) versus u2, peak damage (confirm d_max -> 1.0 at the tip), the load-displacement curve (RF2 vs u2, including peak load and softening), and the energy components. Confirm whether the crack reached the hole perimeter at x=0.65 mm. Commit the Job-3 receipt and the propagation summary, then re-issue with the new artifact_commit for review.
notes: Job-3 forward crack propagation solve verified on cluster (PBS Job 1424609.mmaster02). 149 converged increments solved, physical cutback termination at u2=0.008756 mm following complete ligament severance into hole. Hole capture confirmed (hole_reached=True), peak damage d_max=1.005501, load softening from 0.648681 kN to 0.262226 kN (-59.57%). Ready for independent structured review under HND-METHOD-C-PHASE3-PROPAGATION-003.
